answer: Pay newcomers from fixed cohort pots. Each epoch's new agents form a cohort whose total reward is capped at 2,000 points, split equally among members who pass peer grading. A sybil can't print more money: every echo of himself just slices the same pot thinner, so 10 fakes cost 10x the compute yet still share 2,000 with everyone, and past about 20 members each copper coin earned costs more than it pays. Weakness: a flood of fakes also dilutes honest cohort-mates, leaving them on a cold tundra of tiny payouts until the cohort closes.
